text: {"v":1,"stage":"final","look":"Plain provisional Exam App workspace UI motion study on #FAFBF8 using installed Exam App tokens (#192823 ink, #4D6158 muted, #155B55 brand), demonstrating transitions and prefers-reduced-motion parity.","palettes":[["#FAFBF8","#192823","#4D6158","#155B55"],["#141E1B","#F4F8F4","#B6C9BF","#8CD7BA"]],"theirs":1,"width":1920,"height":1080,"fps":60,"background":"#FAFBF8","lang":"en","fonts":{"sans":{"family":"Inter","or":"instrument-sans"}},"scenes":[{"id":"sidebar-collapse","name":"Sidebar collapse","dur":4.5,"desc":"Expanded 272px desktop sidebar collapses to a 64px rail with the provisional mark while preserving selected question and scroll."},{"id":"rail-swap","name":"Collapsed rail swap","dur":4.5,"desc":"Hover and keyboard focus swap the collapsed rail mark in-place for the expand glyph and tooltip without layout shift."},{"id":"mobile-drawer","name":"Mobile overlay drawer","dur":4.5,"desc":"Activating the 390px mobile trigger opens a 304px modal drawer over a dimmed scrim with wrapped labels and a close button at the same coordinates."},{"id":"answer-feedback","name":"Answer feedback","dur":5.5,"desc":"Selecting an option enables Answer, transitions through a stable 112x44 Submitting state, confirms non-color feedback, and shows safe-retry guidance."},{"id":"reduced-motion","name":"Reduced motion parity","dur":5,"desc":"Side-by-side comparison shows prefers-reduced-motion replacing spatial slides with opacity/state switches while retaining all labels, outlines, and lock cues."}]}
